notes.title: Flife; will be released on Dec 2022!
notes.notes:
https://youtu.be/NSf_mAQ1cuY?si=Cwv_WmciBjoYTr3u

Flife is a challenging climbing game with a knife.
Experience the challenge of climbing with a knife all the way to the end.
Use a tip of your favorite knife to climb the pallets and rack up.
Addictive game, try to get as high as you can with knife throw.
Flife toss and throw knife. High difficulty stylish knives.

■ Flip your knife all the way to the top.
■ There is no save point.
■ Don't give up!
